title: PROCESIO Control Tower — Automation Evidence & Founder Briefing
objective: Turn real CLI, skill-evaluation, field-trial, and repository-health signals into an idempotent evidence ledger, safe operational decisions, a polished intake experience, and an automatically generated founder briefing.
why_it_is_useful: Every future PROCESIO CLI field trial can be normalized and retained instead of disappearing into chat transcripts.
Interrupted evaluations are routed to a safe resume action instead of being retried blindly.
Repository pulse data and platform evidence are combined into one founder-readable briefing.
The project exercises the same platform capabilities the operational skill claims to support and leaves reusable assets behind.

existing_dependency.title: CLI Utility 01 - Evidence Status Normalizer
existing_dependency.policy: Re-use this exact verified process. Never duplicate or edit it during the Control Tower build.

custom_actions_or_connectors: CLI Control Tower - GitHub Public Pulse
credentials: CLI Control Tower - GitHub Public API (only if the custom connector needs a non-secret REST credential)
schedules: CLI Control Tower - Weekly Founder Brief

required_capability_coverage: data model creation with all attributes in the initial create
native PROCESIO data-store provisioning, idempotent row insert/update, filtering, sorting, and CSV export
process DTO build, designer validation, backend validation, create, re-fetch, audit, single-run verification, output inspection, and activation control
Node scripting with explicit Timeout, clean typed outputs, and bound Error outputs
Decisional routing with a default branch and Join convergence
For Each processing of typed evidence rows
custom response mapping for synchronous callers
read-only external API integration through a custom connector, with one successful GitHub call and one expected provider-error test
document-template creation with a repeating evidence table and generated PDF output
published themed form with tabs, validation feedback, synchronous process mapping, and browser-level end-to-end proof
one weekly schedule created disabled, cron-previewed, manually proven through the underlying process, then enabled
transport export of the retained project with digest and no credential secrets
final inventory, duplicate check, dependency audit, direct output proof, and retained-resource manifest

security_and_cost.form_access_token: Generate a random 128-bit token locally; store the clear token only in gitignored scratchpad with mode 0600; persist only its SHA-256 hash in the process definition.
security_and_cost.external_api_operations: GitHub public read-only GET operations only.

schedule.note: The workspace includes 30 free execution hours per month, but this project intentionally uses a small recurring budget and converts it into durable operational value rather than burning runtime.
